reviewContext.userProblem: The macOS agent pane spends too much height on header controls, shows a 'New Chat' title for an empty chat, has a small composer, and is too narrow. The user supplied mockup design-docs/references/agent-pane-redesign/mockup.png (generated with runwayml-cli).
requiredOutcomes: For a new chat, no 'New Chat' text is shown anywhere in the agent pane; the title row is hidden for a new chat and shown compactly only for existing threads.
Chat/History/Summary tab icons and the new-chat/resume buttons are small compact icon buttons (24x18 compact IconSegmentedControl size) in one slim toolbar row.
The scope picker is one slim row of tiny icons; the scope description moves into a help tooltip on an info icon.
The composer TextEditor is taller: new chat min 180, ideal 280, max .infinity; existing chats min 180, ideal 240, max 360 points.
On macOS the agent pane defaults to 640pt width with min 520 and max 1100; stored widths are clamped on read into 520...1100 without migration.
mise run build, swiftlint and mise run test pass.
nonGoals: No change to Sources/StriaCore, including AgentPaneViewModel.chatTitle, which keeps its 'New Chat' fallback for Mobile and tests.
No change to IconSegmentedControl regular metrics or its other callers (LeftPaneView.swift, SearchViews.swift, the History tab control).
No change to the 1000-point agentVisible threshold, 760-point sidebar threshold, left pane width, compact lower-half agent or SplitWidthKeeper drag/restore logic.
No new keyboard shortcuts, symbols or menu commands.
constraints: Do not modify unrelated files; preserve the user's uncommitted icon changes (Mobile/StriaMobile/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/Stria-Paper.png, Resources/Stria.icns, design-docs/stria-app-icon.md).
Keep Swift files under 1000 lines; run swiftlint.
Keep keyboard shortcuts, help tooltips and accessibility labels working.
Do not break the iOS/iPadOS Mobile/StriaMobile build that shares StriaCore.
No emojis. No AI attribution in commits. No git push.
Workers make no git state changes; each plan edits only its writePaths and its own plan Progress Log.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Add opt-in IconSegmentedControlSize (regular 30x22 default font, compact 24x18 .system(size: 11), separator equals segment height), declared after segments.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Existing callers compile unchanged and regular rendering stays identical; P15 reuses the compact metrics for standalone toolbar buttons.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Show the chat title row only when currentThread != nil or the transcript contains a user message.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Mirrors the branches of AgentPaneViewModel.chatTitle (AgentPaneViewModel.swift:316-320), so the 'New Chat' fallback is never rendered without changing StriaCore.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Agent pane width constants min 520 / default 640 / max 1100 defined once in ReaderView.swift and applied through one clamp helper in both the frame and SplitWidthKeeper.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Prevents the keeper fighting the frame for stored values above 1100; read-side clamp avoids a migration and view-update loops.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Scope description moves to an info.circle icon's help and accessibility label.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: An outer help on the row would be hidden by each segment's own tooltip.

intentionalTradeoffs: Compact 24x18 hit targets are smaller than the regular 30x22.
The compact lower-half agent leaves less transcript space with the taller composer.
StriaApp has no UI test target; the rendered layout is checked visually against the mockup at integration review.
supportedEdgeCases: New chat (no thread, empty transcript): no title row or divider; toolbar, scope row, 32-point transcript, composer fills the rest.
After the first question is sent (provisional user message): title row shows the question's first line.
Thread reopened from History: title row shows the thread title.
Stored width 360 or 480 opens at 520; 700 stays 700; 1300 opens at 1100; no stored value opens at 640.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: iPad/iPhone MobileAgentView layout and its 'New Chat' title.

acceptanceCriteria: IconSegmentedControlSize with regular/compact and segmentWidth, segmentHeight, symbolFont exists in Sources/StriaApp/IconSegmentedControl.swift.
IconSegmentedControl has var size: IconSegmentedControlSize = .regular declared after segments; existing callers compile unchanged.
The 30/22 numbers appear only in the metric definitions; regular rendering is unchanged.
Only Sources/StriaApp/IconSegmentedControl.swift and the plan Progress Log change.
readerAgentPaneWidth AppStorage default is the 640 constant; the key string is unchanged.
No literal 480 or 800 remains for agent pane width; 520/640/1100 appear only in the constants.
The agent pane frame and SplitWidthKeeper use the same clamp helper into 520...1100.
Only Sources/StriaApp/ReaderView.swift and the plan Progress Log change.
'"New Chat"' appears only in the New Chat button's accessibilityLabel.
scopeDescription is used only in .help and .accessibilityLabel (no Text).
TextEditor frame: minHeight 180, idealHeight isNewChat ? 280 : 240, maxHeight isNewChat ? .infinity : 360.
Title row and its divider render only when currentThread != nil or the transcript contains a user message.
Only Sources/StriaApp/AgentPaneView.swift and the plan Progress Log change; file stays under 1000 lines.
